notes:
Lead profile: Series A (2023), YC alum founders, building smart reconciliation + customer support for SMB merchants. Primary contact: Maya Lin (CTO). Motivation: improve agent response quality for transaction disputes and reduce manual triage.

Technical asks / constraints:
- Starting on hosted API (public cloud) but "vpc-curious" for Dedicated later; wants simple migration path.
- Early security checklist: SOC2 type II copy, SSO (SAML) + IdP integration, audit logs retention (90 days) — legal will need SOC2 before contract.
- Scale target: ~200k messages/month in Q3; p95 latency target for chat ~250ms, embeddings lookup <100ms for 2k vectors; cost-sensitive (unit-cost comparison to other hosted vendors).
- Model preference: open/Redwood-curated smaller LLM for support assistant; willing to test GPT-like for tricky edge cases with fallback routing. Interested in recommendations for batching + caching to lower token spend.

What we heard on call (paraphrased):
- "We want to stay on hosted as long as possible; only move to Dedicated if latency/cost benefit is clear." — Maya
- Concerned about PII in support transcripts; asks for KMS options and redaction guidance.

POC ask: simple proof-of-value in 2 weeks — 1) Deploy hosted API endpoint for support-assistant, 2) Plug embeddings search on 10k internal help articles, 3) Run 1k simulated user sessions and produce latency/cost report.

Sales notes / playbook suggestions: quick send SOC2 summary + SSO setup guide, include sample code snippet for redaction + client-side hashing, propose 2-week POC plan with measurable SLAs. Keep messaging emphasizing low-friction hosted -> Dedicated migration.
